title: Vaai Kozhuppu
desc: Bhaskar struggles to earn the admiration and approval of his rich father-in-law. To make matters worse, he is constantly belittled by the elder son-in-law of the family.

title: Taj Mahal
desc: Maayan falls in love with Machakanni, a woman whose engagement was recently called off. However, a rivalry between their respective villages threatens their relationship.

title: Shock
desc: Vasanth and Malini move into a new flat and learn that a woman had committed suicide in the apartment. After a while, Vasanth notices that Malini has started behaving in a strange manner.

title: Uyarntha Ullam
desc: Anand, a drunkard, gets into a brawl and is saved by Selvam, whom he appoints as his personal assistant. Later, he falls in love with Geetha and decides to transform his lifestyle.

title: Muthina Kathirika
desc: A rural politician faces many challenges because of his ideologies. He also struggles as he tries to balance his political career and new-found love interest.
